FluidR3_GM piano samples
=======================

Soundfont by Frank Wen, with contributions credited below. MP3 conversion by
Benjamin Gleitzman; distributed by Paul Rosen for abcjs.

Source: https://github.com/paulrosen/midi-js-soundfonts
Sample distribution license: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 United States
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/us/
Source license notice: https://github.com/paulrosen/midi-js-soundfonts#soundfonts-available

This site redistributes 73 unmodified acoustic-grand-piano MP3 samples used by
its published scores. No other instruments are included.
